A: coverage against |bias| / SD (log axis; cells with |bias|/SD < 0.01 drawn at 0.01); B: coverage against the leverage L of the
corner contrast, for cells with small bias (|bias|/SD < 0.25, orange) and the rest (grey). Dashed line: 0.95. Large dots: mean coverage per bin (x at the median of the bin).
Bernoulli designs, mechanisms (a)-(f), the true graph (edge-noise, no-baseline sanity and convex-mirror runs left out), every graph family and d, p grid, in A and B; cluster-design cells are listed in the appendix table (the HC0 interval is a unit-level interval).
